name: Jagannath Temple, NTPC Township
town_description: Ramagundam is an industrial city in Peddapalli district on the Godavari, dominated by the NTPC Ramagundam Super Thermal Power Station at Jyothinagar (505215) - a 2600 MW station, the largest power station in South India and India's first ISO-14001-certified super thermal station - plus Singareni collieries at Godavarikhani. The NTPC township houses staff from across India, with a strong Odia community served by township temples.
